senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. Sharon, plain along the Mediterranean coast from Japho to Carmel.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 20:4">Lev. R. s. 20</cite> <he>על אחינו שבש׳ וכ׳</he> for our brethren in Sharon (the high priest prayed,) that their houses might not become their graves; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 5:2:5">Y. Yoma V, 42ᶜ</cite> top <he>על אנשי הש׳</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 8:3">Sot. VIII, 3</cite> <he>אף הבונה … בש׳ לא היה חוזר</he> he also who built a brick-house in Sharon was not excused from the army; Y. ib. 23ᵃ top <he>אף אנשי הש׳ לא היו וכ׳</he> the men of Sh. were not excused, because their houses had to be renovated twice in every Sabbatical period; Bab.

<cite ref="Tosefta Menahot 9:13">Tosef. Men. IX, 13</cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 87a:16">Men. 87ᵃ</cite> <he>עגלים מש׳</he> calves (for public sacrifices) were brought from Sh.; a. e.—Denom. <he>שָׁרוֹנִי</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 2:7">Nidd. II, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:3">Cant. R. to VII, 3</cite> <he>יין הש׳</he> Sharon (red) wine.
